notes.title: More Updates !!
notes.content:
- Improved shuttlecock / racket collision physics
- Ability to float in the air and perform mid air shots
- More control over player movements on the court
- Hit backward shots by pressing and holding the left grip button

notes.title: UPDATE + Major Bug Fixes + Swing Hard !!!
notes.content:
We have taken in to account your feedback on the game and released a major physics update to "Space Badminton VR".

Update Details:

- The shuttlecock no longer shoots off in random directions when hit by the racket
- You are given the ability to control the force on the shuttlecock by real life hand speed 
- You can now swing as fast as you want !!

Watch out for a minor bug: You cannot hit the shuttlecock in the backward direction. We are working on this and hope this will not hinder your game play. 

Thank You
Life VR Team
